targets.visualRule: Warm modular thatch roof cells for the Eldoria Village shop. Base and moss variants must repeat without hard seams; ridge is a deliberate feature cell. All variants share the farm environment's upper-left light and weathered wood material language.
notes: Specification only; no art is included by this target document.
Source/review approval does not authorize map or Phaser integration.

renderLayer is actors_body, not terrain: a structure must Y-sort against the hero by its ground contact so the hero can pass behind it. Owner decision (Leo, 2026-07-26, in session): every building and tall prop is an actor, never terrain. Applied here alongside tile_village_shop_wall and tile_village_shop_door in farm_village_tile_targets.json; this family lives in its own file, which is why it was missed on the first pass.

collision.solid true is a per-tile target declaration and is NOT what the shipped Village composition does: src/data/villageShopBuilding.ts makes only the structure's bottom two rows solid, so the roof rows overhang walkable ground and the hero can pass behind them. A roof that were solid on its own would remove the overhang and with it the occlusion. Reconciling this declaration with the composition is an open owner question.
